To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Max-value Entropy (MES) Search, a new Bayesian optimization method, is more efficient than the popular Entropy Search (Es)/ Predictive Entropy (pes) Search methods, because the former is more robust to the computational cost of estimating entropy, and therefore more scalable to high-dimensional problems.
MES is more robust to the sample size used for computing the entropies, and hence more computationally efficient than ES and PES.
MES (1) has a regret bound that is similar to ES/PES, (2) has similar empirical performance as ES/PES, and (3) is computationally much more efficient than ES/PES.
